### Custom date formatting

This example shows how to use `formatDateToString` and `formatStringToDate` callback props to customize the format
used for display and keyboard input of dates.
You also need to set `dateFormat`, `datePattern`, `dateSeparator` and `locale` props accordingly.

In this example, we want users to be able to type a date with the `dd-MMM-yyyy` format.
We use `Intl.DateTimeFormat` API get the short month string depending on specified `locale`.

This example also demonstrate usage of `onValidation` callback to know when the date format is invalid.

<Canvas of={DatePickerStories.CustomFormat} />
